name: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence (arXiv:2507.20534)
notes: Primary source for Kimi K2's vendor-stated 1T total / 32B activated and for its architecture lineage: K2 is DeepSeek-V3-shaped (MLA, kv_lora_rank 512, 384 routed + 1 shared expert, 8 active per token) but trained with the Muon optimizer. Confirms the MLA cache geometry used for the kv_cache_bytes_per_token derivation.
